type MapText<T extends string> = Capitalize<T>;
type EmptyText = Exclude<string, string>;
const upper = (input: Uppercase<EmptyText>): never => input;
const lower = (input: Lowercase<never>): never => input;
const capitalized = (input: MapText<never>): never => input;
const uncapitalized = (input: Uncapitalize<never>): never => input;
console.log('ok');
